evals.prompt: I installed hundreds of Skills into one flat directory. Load the AI Coding OS shared naming vocabulary and tell me which Skill owns frontend state terms.
evals.expected_output: Uses $ai-coding-os-suite-contracts, reads only its local references, identifies $frontend-architecture as the semantic owner, and does not assume a grouped sibling path.

evals.prompt: Use the AI Coding OS Harness Result contract to explain observed, supports, and not_proven.
evals.expected_output: Loads the local Harness vocabulary/schema, preserves the claim boundary, and names $product-harness-system as the owning doctrine when semantic judgment is needed.

evals.prompt: Define this project's customer, workspace, and billing terminology inside the Suite contract registry.
evals.expected_output: Declines to make project product language a Suite default and places adopted terms in project-owned SSoT/Standards instead.

evals.prompt: List every AI Coding OS Skill installed on this machine from the contracts package.
evals.expected_output: Uses runtime discovery for the actual installed set and does not treat the contracts package as a static Skill roster.
